definitions.explanation: The ability to govern or control oneself according to one's own principles, without external control. Also used in technical contexts for autonomous systems or the autonomic nervous system.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{自律|じりつ}{心|しん}を{育|そだ}てたい。
examples.english: I want to nurture my child's sense of self-discipline.

examples.japanese: ストレスで{自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}が{乱|みだ}れている。
examples.english: Stress is disrupting my autonomic nervous system.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}が{自律|じりつ}して{働|はたら}ける{環境|かんきょう}を{整|ととの}えることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to create an environment where employees can work autonomously.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguish from the homophone {自立|じりつ} (independence, self-reliance): {自律|じりつ} emphasizes internal self-governance and discipline (律 = law/regulation), while {自立|じりつ} emphasizes standing on one's own feet financially or physically (立 = stand).

{自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい} (autonomic nervous system) is a very common compound — {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}{失調症|しっちょうしょう} (autonomic nervous system disorder) is frequently discussed in health contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}: autonomic nervous system
- {自律|じりつ}{心|しん}: self-discipline, autonomy
- {自律|じりつ}した{学習|がくしゅう}: self-directed learning
- {自律|じりつ}{型|がた}ロボット: autonomous robot
